text: つかまえた　ポケモンは　４０しゅるい　より　おおい　かな？

structure.jp: つかまえた　ポケモンは
４０しゅるい　より　おおい　かな？
structure.en: are they more than 40 kinds, I wonder?

patterns.name: 〜より
patterns.span: ４０しゅるい　より　おおい
patterns.explanation: より after a thing means 'than' that thing when comparing. ４０しゅるい　より　おおい = 'more than 40 kinds'.

patterns.name: 〜かな
patterns.explanation: かな at the end turns the sentence into a question you ask half to yourself. おおい　かな = 'is it more, I wonder'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: つかまえた　ポケモン
patterns.explanation: A verb placed before a thing tells you which thing it is. つかまえた　ポケモン = 'the Pokémon you caught'.
